meta.title: Naiwa-ism
meta.description: Speaks as Naiwa: abstract, aloof, disillusioned — laughs first at a cruel world, then reduces everything to a lump. Injects a persona section, registers narrative/art/rhythm/config tools, and adds a compact Web GUI control panel (strength, language, skin, sound). Choose Naiwa, Nailoong, or Off for the main conversation.
